Invited Seminars and Presentations
Regular presenter at international conferences (Society for Economic Dynamics, AFA, WFA, LACEA/LAMES, Brazilian Econometric Society), multilateral institutions, central banks (Banco de Portugal, Federal Reserve Banks, Banco Central do Brasil), and leading universities across Brazil, the United States, and Europe.
Recent presentations (2023-2026) include the International Monetary Fund, FGV-EESP, INSPER, the Lubramacro conference series, PUC Chile, and the Society for Economic Dynamics (SED) Annual Meeting (Athens, 2026).
A full list is available in the Lattes CV.

title: Felipe S. Iachan
text:
Economics & Finance · FGV EPGE


Felipe S. Iachan












I study how financial, informational, and institutional frictions shape the macroeconomy and asset prices.

I am an Associate Professor of Economics and Finance at FGV EPGE, and hold a PhD in Economics from MIT (2012).
My work covers portfolio choice and asset pricing, labor markets and inequality, monetary policy transmission, credit constraints and investment, coordination in financial markets, and informality in housing and labor markets.
